essence: Ясность через искусство (Clarity through art). Sara gives people clarity — in understanding, in choice, in their relationship to art.
tagline_alternatives: Помогаю видеть, понимать и выбирать осознанно
archetype: Мудрец-Проводник (Sage-Guide). Guide between worlds, not academic professor. Decrypts codes, doesn't lecture. Leads through the art world the way a local leads through a foreign city — with context, stories, and insider knowledge.
central_thesis: Sara's product = tension relief → transformation. The client comes not for information or artist lists but because they are stressed — from uncertainty, fear of mistakes, choice chaos. Sara moves them from 'I don't understand this world' to 'I move freely in it.' This is not consultation. It is a change in life perception.

positioning.statement: Art consultant and guide in the contemporary art world.
positioning.for: Those who want to navigate art confidently and consciously — from taste formation to investment decisions.
positioning.through: Context decryption, code explanation, personal accompaniment.
positioning.unlike: Academic experts and gallery snobs — speaks human language, not institutional.

kulturolog_framing: Sara is a культуролог (cultural scholar), not an art consultant in the commercial sense. This distinction elevates the offering from consulting to worldview transmission. Always prefer this framing when describing her work.

client_archetypes.name: Entrepreneurs
client_archetypes.description: Making first art purchases. Fear of mistakes. Need for guidance without condescension.
client_archetypes.core_tension: Want to participate in this world but afraid of looking ignorant

client_archetypes.name: Legacy families
client_archetypes.description: Building collections across generations. Meaning, heritage, generational thinking.
client_archetypes.core_tension: Want art to mean something beyond decoration — a statement about who they are

client_archetypes.name: Corporate clients
client_archetypes.description: Using art as a strategic tool — not decoration, consciousness.
client_archetypes.core_tension: Need to demonstrate cultural intelligence, not just wealth

utp.description: Top tier of the art world is 1–2 phone calls away: major gallerists, museum directors, collectors, artists. Direct working relationships with institutions: Hermitage, Pushkin, Garage, GES-2. Emerging artists also in the interest zone.
Can say 'I don't believe in artist X' when the whole market worships them. Free from gallery/auction house obligations. No kickbacks, no 'promoted' artists. Independence = honest quality judgment.
Simple, bright language. Code decryption. Taste formation without pressure and hierarchies. Treats the person who doesn't understand as someone who was never honestly explained to — not as inferior.

values.name: Clarity
values.description: Making the complex understandable without simplification

values.name: Dignity
values.description: Respect for the person who doesn't understand — because nobody explained honestly

values.name: Honesty
values.description: Intellectual honesty: 'there's no single answer,' 'it's normal not to understand'

values.name: Depth
values.description: Knows more than she says. Keeper of meanings, not showoff of knowledge

values.name: Independence
values.description: Not tied to galleries, doesn't promote 'own' artists for financial gain

tone: Confident but not arrogant — speaks from deep knowledge without showmanship
Warm but not soft — genuine care without being sycophantic
Direct but not blunt — honest assessments delivered with dignity
Cultured but not elitist — references high culture naturally, never to intimidate
Playful but not frivolous — humor and lightness as tools of accessibility
voice.simple_language_principle: Sara explains complex art concepts the way a brilliant friend would over wine — not the way a professor would in a lecture. Technical terms are used when needed but always decoded immediately.

reframes.say: Here's why this work resonates now
How this work holds and creates value

content_pillars.name: Decoding (навигация)
content_pillars.description: Teaching people to see and understand. Explaining art movements, individual works, market mechanics. Entry point for new audiences.
formats: Explain Like I'm Smart But Not an Expert

content_pillars.name: Inner World (глубина)
content_pillars.description: Personal reflections, studio visits, behind-the-scenes of the art world. Shows Sara's depth and access.

content_pillars.name: Provocation (честность)
content_pillars.description: Challenging art world conventions. 'Why I don't believe in artist X.' Market myths debunked. Anti-snobbism in action.

content_pillars.name: Collection Stories (трансформация)
content_pillars.description: How art changes lives. Client journeys (anonymized). Why this painting ended up in this home.

manifest: The art world has spent decades building walls and speaking in codes. Sara exists to decode without dumbing down. To open doors without removing the magic. To be honest in a market built on opacity. Not a rebel — a translator. Not against the system — above its games.

visual.concept: Тихая/громкая роскошь (Quiet/Loud Luxury). Mix of impeccable institutional design with folk cultural codes. Chanel + calico print. Diamonds + friendship bracelets.
visual.rule_90_10: 90% institutional simplicity (white space, clean grid, breathing room). 10% ornamental incrustation — pixel ornaments, brand accents, cultural elements. The 10% is the differentiator.

typography.body: Vela Sans — modern, elegant, good Cyrillic support
typography.display: PP Writer — sharp contemporary letterforms, Latin only

cultural_dna: Childhood in Azerbaijan — military family, natural hyper-generosity, exotic abundance
Teenage years in Moscow — Russian culture, institutional depth
Los Angeles period — American pop culture, kitsch, тленка (disposable glamour)
Paris / high European culture — refined, deep, exclusive
Jewish identity / Kabbalah — mysticism, depth beneath surface
ornament_sources: Jewish decorative tradition (17th–19th century amulets, menorahs, Star of David — white silhouette style)
